## LoadedApprovalGate type

The governance-context fragment a loaded approval gate produces.

Carries the writer alongside the gate so the two travel together — a caller spreads this into their governance context and cannot end up seeking approval with no audit sink.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type LoadedApprovalGate = Pick<GovernanceContextWithApprovals, 'writer' | 'approvals'>
```

**References:** [GovernanceContextWithApprovals](./runtime.governancecontextwithapprovals.md)
